questions.explanation: The blank is filled by ‘غ’, which means ‘the letter ghayn’ and fits the setting. A voiced velar fricative with a dot above. The other forms belong to different items; choosing one would make the dialogue coherent in grammar but wrong in meaning.

options.misconception: treats a correct Latin rendering as the error

options.text: The gloss is ‘the letter jim’. — A labiodental fricative with one dot above. [الدرس ١.١٠ / السؤال ٠٠٤٠]
The gloss is ‘the letter fa’. [الدرس ١.١٠ / السؤال ٠٠٤٠]
options.misconception: mistakes an accurate meaning for the unsupported statement

questions.explanation: The faulty claim assigns ‘the letter jim’ to ‘fāʾ’, but ‘fāʾ’ means ‘the letter fa’. A labiodental fricative with one dot above. The spelling, the transliteration and the gloss are all accurate descriptions, so none of them can be the wrong statement the item asks for.
questions.hint: Find the statement that swaps in a meaning from a different item.
